summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Phase 6 acceptance harness (/phase6-acceptance) for this session's 4 features: pre-filled defaults, AsyncStorage persistence, Section 4 matrix auto-derivation with manual-override lock/unlock, and Section 5 gap / Section 6 verdict auto-derivation with lock. All core flows verified working correctly on mobile viewport (375x667). No crashes, no red screens. One environment-inherent limitation found in 'Start new session' (see below) -- not a code bug, but worth flagging.

ui_bugs.issue: react-native-web's Alert class (node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert) is a no-op stub -- it does not render window.confirm or any dialog. Tapping 'Start new session (clear everything)' in the WEB PREVIEW does literally nothing: no dialog appears, and state is NOT cleared (verified: a field filled before the tap still held its value after the tap, with zero dialog events observed via Playwright's page.on('dialog')). This is a react-native-web platform limitation, not an app code bug -- Alert.alert(title, msg, buttons) only works on native iOS/Android. The feature should work correctly on a physical device build. Flagging per the review request's own caveat ('if testable in this environment') -- it is NOT testable/functional in this environment at all, so main agent/tester should not rely on web preview to validate the clear-session flow; needs on-device or Expo Go verification.
ui_bugs.priority: LOW (environment limitation, not fixable in web preview)

verified_working.prefilled_defaults: Confirmed on fresh load (no AsyncStorage state): Branch='main', Job name(s)='Gate Guard, android-dev-build', Artifact name(s)='android-dev-build, gate-guard', APK filename='app-release.apk', Backend branch='main', Build source radio 'CI artifact' selected, Private DNS provider hostname default='dns.google'. All pre-filled instead of blank.
verified_working.persistence: Filled 'Completed by' text field, toggled VPN-permission checkbox, and selected 'Another VPN was active' radio, then did a full page.reload() (simulates force-close+relaunch). All 3 field types restored correctly after reload (confirmed via input value + visual screenshot showing checkbox checked and radio dot filled). AsyncStorage round-trip via PHASE6_STORAGE_KEY works as designed.
verified_working.matrix_auto_derivation_group1: After running 'Run positive enforcement test' (waited full ~22s), row 1.1 auto-filled to FAIL with evidenceRef 'Attempt #1 (auto)' and notes 'No THREAT_BLOCKED observed within window' -- exactly the expected web-preview behavior (no native module) -- without any tap. Confirmed row 1.2 requires a 2nd positive-test run to auto-fill (by design, since dnsBucket 'off' counter increments per run) -- this is correct matrix design, not a bug.
verified_working.matrix_manual_override_and_lock: Tapping PASS chip on row 1.1 manually changed note to the exact expected text 'Your manual override (auto-suggestions won't overwrite this row anymore).' Re-running the positive test afterward did NOT overwrite the manual PASS (verified row text unchanged after re-run) -- lock holds correctly. Tapping 'clear' chip released the lock and note reverted to 'Not run yet — this fills in automatically...' -- unlock behavior confirmed correct.
verified_working.matrix_groups_2_and_3: All 5 negative tests (rule-match-alone, manual-override, local-analysis-only, gate-start-alone, failed-dns-forward) auto-filled rows 2.1-2.5 (each shows a 'clear' chip appearing, confirming a result was auto-set) after waiting their ~6-7s windows. All 4 snapshot buttons (stop/revoke/restart/network) auto-filled rows 3.1-3.4 to PASS.
verified_working.matrix_group4_and_gap_auto_derivation: Set Private DNS radio to 'Automatic', re-ran positive test -> row 4.2 auto-filled to 'BYPASSED' (expected in web preview, no native capture). Section 5 gap-0 checkbox 'I exercised this bypass path' auto-checked itself and Observed impact auto-populated with '4.2 (Automatic)=BYPASSED' -- no manual tap needed, matching spec exactly.
verified_working.gap_lock: Manually checking gap-0 checkbox BEFORE any Group 4 result, then running the positive test with DNS=Automatic afterward, did NOT overwrite/populate the Observed impact field (stayed empty) -- confirms manual toggle correctly locks the gap against auto-overwrite.
verified_working.verdict_auto_derivation: Before Groups 1-3 fully filled, verdict note correctly read 'Not enough matrix rows filled in yet to suggest a verdict — run more tests above.' with no chip selected. After running positive test TWICE (filling both 1.1 and 1.2), all 5 negative tests, and all 4 snapshots (Groups 1-3 fully filled), verdict auto-selected 'FAIL' (correct per rule: Group 1 rows were both FAIL) and Justification auto-populated with exact matrix summary string 'Group 1: 1.1=FAIL, 1.2=FAIL. Group 2: 2.1=PASS,... Group 4: 4.1=FAIL, 4.2=not run,...' -- all without tapping a verdict chip or the Refresh button.
verified_working.regression: Checkbox/RadioGroup components (VPN/Notif perm checkboxes, Build source/Architecture/VPN state/Private DNS radios) all functional. Test domain + matching rule ID auto-fill from M2 bundle confirmed ('blocktest.btciq.app' / 'm2-block-blocktest-001'). Back button present with testID phase6-back-button (not clicked to avoid losing test session mid-run, but element verified present/tappable size).

action_items: No code fix required for the Alert.alert web no-op -- it's a react-native-web platform limitation. Recommend documenting in the harness screen or README that 'Start new session' clear-flow can only be exercised on a real device / Expo Go, not the web preview, so testers/reviewers don't mistake it for broken.

Consider (optional, not blocking) adding a web-only fallback using window.confirm inside startNewSession() so this flow is at least testable in web preview too, e.g. `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm(...)) { clear... } } else { Alert.alert(...) }`.
critical_code_review_comments: phase6-acceptance.tsx is now 1199 lines, well past the 700-line guideline (grew significantly again this session with persistence/auto-derivation logic). Strongly recommend splitting into e.g. phase6-acceptance/ProvenanceSection.tsx, MatrixSection.tsx, VerdictSection.tsx, and a usePhase6Persistence.ts hook for the AsyncStorage load/save effect, to keep the screen component itself manageable.

Lock/unlock UX is inconsistent across the 3 auto-derivation targets: matrix rows get a 'clear' chip to release the lock, verdict gets a 'resume auto-suggest' chip, but Section 5 gaps have NO way to release gapLocked[i] once set (setGapLocked always sets to true on any manual checkbox/text interaction, with no UI control to reset it back to false). Not explicitly required by the review request, but worth a follow-up for parity.

The verdict auto-derivation useEffect (lines ~401-424) recalculates and calls autoFillJustification() on every matrix change whenever !verdictLocked, which will silently overwrite manual edits to the Justification field alone (i.e. a tester who edits Justification text without ever tapping a verdict chip will have their edit wiped out the next time any matrix row changes). Justification has no independent lock -- it's only protected indirectly by verdictLocked. Minor edge case, not exercised by the review request's test list, but flagging for awareness.

AsyncStorage read/write effects (lines ~269-317) correctly guard against saving before hydration completes (hydratingRef/hydrated flag), preventing a race where defaults would overwrite persisted state on mount -- good defensive pattern.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable-in-web-preview requested features verified working (pre-filled defaults, persistence, matrix auto-derivation + manual override lock/unlock, gap auto-derivation + lock, verdict auto-derivation). 1 feature (Start new session confirm dialog) is untestable in web preview due to react-native-web's Alert.alert being a no-op stub -- environment limitation, not a code defect.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested feature areas for this session (pre-filled defaults, AsyncStorage persistence across reload, Section 4 matrix auto-derivation with lock-on-override, Section 5 gap + Section 6 verdict auto-derivation with lock) are verified working correctly via Playwright on mobile viewport. Key timing notes confirmed accurate: positive test needs ~20-22s, negative tests ~6-7.5s each, before results appear -- scripts must wait these full windows. Group 1 matrix needs the positive test run TWICE (dns=off both times) to fill both 1.1 and 1.2 before verdict auto-derivation can trigger (by design, not a bug). The only unverifiable-in-web item is the 'Start new session' Alert.alert confirm dialog, which is a complete no-op on react-native-web (no dialog, no state change) -- this needs on-device/Expo-Go testing, not web preview.
rca_of_issue: Alert.alert no-op: react-native-web@0.21.2's Alert export (node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert/index.js) does not implement any browser dialog polyfill for multi-button alerts -- confirmed by direct file inspection. This is a known react-native-web limitation, not an app-level bug. Mitigation options: (1) accept as expected web-preview limitation and test only on device, or (2) add a Platform.OS === 'web' branch using window.confirm as a fallback so the clear-session flow is testable everywhere.
